caption:
A devastating road accident in Natore has claimed 14 lives and left 26 injured after a bus and a sand-laden truck collided head-on early Tuesday morning.

Fourteen people were killed and at least 26 others injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a sand-laden truck in Natore’s Baraigram Upazila.

The tragic accident occurred on the Natore-Pabna Highway, outside the Bonpara Police Investigation Centre, around 4:15 AM on Tuesday.

According to Additional Superintendent of Police Iftekharul Alam, a sand-laden truck crashed into a bus traveling from Barishal to Rajshahi.

Authorities are working to identify the deceased. The injured individuals have been promptly sent to various hospitals for medical treatment.
